review.reason: This chunk adds bounded reliability checks: it explicitly rejects cases where artifact preparation succeeded but finalization failed or returned fewer items. This prevents downstream processing errors while remaining localised to CloudArtifactService. It lacks broader systemic reach and does not demonstrate recovery or cross-component safeguards, so it cannot earn 3.
review.posthog_relevance: Desktop recordings rely on uploading attachments to S3 before storing them as session artifacts. A silent skip could corrupt recorded sessions. This change improves robustness by failing fast.
review.uncertainty: No execution results or production behavior is demonstrated; we see implementation and its associated unit test, which supports Tier 2.
